disposition: record clean-clone receipts and publish only after transition review and merge; no scientific stage is re-run

failure.root_cause: record_clean_clone_verification required clean_report['install']['passed'] is True, but the only producer of a clean report, final_revision_cleanclone.verify_clean_checkout, never emits an install key. The string 'install' occurs zero times in that module. Every possible clean report was refused, so CLEAN_CLONE, REGENERATION and INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION were unobtainable and publish() refused permanently.
secondary: campaign.verify() wrote its whole-inventory report to SUBSTRATE_FINAL_REVISION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.json, the same path written by record_clean_clone_verification with the stronger {complete: true, separate_clean_process: true} payload. Because verify()'s completeness includes the seven documents only publish() writes, any verify() after a successful record destroyed the strong receipt. publish() calls verify() at the end, so this fired on the publication path itself.
No CLI command reached record_clean_clone_verification; it had zero call sites in the repository.

repair.behavior: treat installation as an operator action carrying its own verified receipt, rather than a field the frozen verifier was never written to emit
repair.clean_clone_install_receipt: verifies an existing install rather than performing or claiming one: resolves the clone venv interpreter, imports substrate with -I from a working directory outside the clone, asserts the resolved module path lies inside the clone, and resolves every declared non-extra requirement through importlib.metadata
repair.cli: substrate final-revision record-clean-clone CLEAN_REPORT_JSON REGENERATION_REPORT_JSON CLONE_ROOT
repair.dependency_check_method: importlib.metadata requirement resolution, not 'pip check': a uv-created virtual environment carries no pip, so 'python -m pip check' fails there for a reason unrelated to install soundness and would have refused every honest clean clone
repair.record_clean_clone_verification: accepts an explicit install_report; prefers clean_report['install'] when present for forward compatibility; records install_receipt_source; every other precondition unchanged
repair.verify_receipt_preservation: verify() writes the independent-verification path only when no existing document carries separate_clean_process true; no completeness escape clause, so publish()'s own final verify() cannot clobber the strong receipt
